stateNote: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (392 °F). Line a baking pan and spread flour onto it. Cook in oven for 5 minutes to kill any harmful bacteria. Alternatively, you can microwave the flour in intervals of 20 seconds, stirring between each interval, until the temperature reaches 75°C (167°F).
